""" def render_html_output(user_input: str) -> str: """ Construct a safe HTML response by embedding the provided user input into a predefined template. The function escapes any special characters in the user input to prevent script injection attacks. Args: user_input (str): Content supplied by the user. Returns: str: The complete HTML page with the escaped user content. """ # Escape special HTML characters to neutralize potential scripts. safe_content = html.escape(user_input, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
